reason: Initial-import average is near neutral, ranges overlap, reload order reverses in the last pair, and first-to-last baseline drift exceeds the average improvement. No clear total-time improvement beyond variability was established in the specified 4+4 runs. Getter cost reduction alone is not an adoption criterion.
method: Mac Apple M1 / Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4 headless / 1920x1080 / same mixed-1000 bytes. Normal order before,after,after,before,after,before,before,after: 4 fresh-browser runs per variant, each cold+reload. Separate wrapped-read diagnostics: before,after,after,before (2 per variant). No builds/tests run concurrently. Cold is first Project import into loaded editor, not browser startup. CDP times overlap and diagnostics are never used as normal latency.

report.method: Cold means first Project import into a loaded editor, not browser startup. Each phase ends after text settles, font readiness, image decode and 2 rAF. CPU sampling changes timing; do not compare it as normal latency. CDP durations overlap; GC, hashes, projection and old URL checks are after timing. Projection equality covers cold/reload of the same build only.
